topic: Berkshire Hathaway turned $1,000 into roughly $30 million since 1965 -- at "only" about 20% a year, compounded
title: How 20% A Year Becomes $30 Million
description:
A $1,000 investment in Berkshire Hathaway in 1965 would be worth roughly $30 million today. The secret isn't a risky strategy, but the mathematical power of compounding over a very long time.
